clauses.S05-004: Port mechanisms with explicit eligibility, lag, saturation, bounds and overlap groups: renewable displacement, EV stock turnover, activity and intensity, and policy. implementation.change: Machine-readable path declarations include native cell scope, power/adoption outputs, timing, bounds, saturation, overlap group and non-calibrated coefficient status. Shared executable eligibility/lag/overlap helpers are actually called by the engine, not a refusal-only wrapper.

Native engine version 3. Explicit generic abatement eligibility excludes power, land and aggregate aviation/marine codes; exact scoped measures can address aviation/marine. Fractional abatement of a signed land sink refuses rather than weakening removals. Zero-addressable road avoids 0/0 at an initially fully electric fleet.

Every actual bound parameter consumption receipt carries its exact native mechanism declaration. Canonical role, source-byte verification, sensitivity admission, joint-distribution and inventory acceptance gates unchanged.
Curated trace points to native declaration and bound-path receipt without inventing curated-to-regional distribution bridges.
Configuration descriptions disclose exact generic exclusions, corporate sensitivity status and signed-land measure refusal.
Narrow exact-version compatibility update to consume actual engine version 3; no route changes.

52 exhaustive supported parameter templates, including scope strings and permission/provenance leaves. Every numerical trajectory leaf is checked against its declared downstream scope. Native and reporting aggregates are independently recomputed exactly from cells. All active supported drivers must actually move output; no generic notDeepEqual-only substitute for isolation.

formulas.fleet: fleet[t]=fleet[t-1]+(sales[t-1]-fleet[t-1])*fleetTurnover; never an instantaneous replacement by sales share
formulas.roadTailpipe: technical=(fleet-initialFleet)/(1-initialFleet*tailpipeReduction)*passengerFraction*tailpipeReduction, only native CO2 road codes starting 1.A.3.b; negative change requires explicit reversal permission
formulas.globalActivityIntensity: ((1+annualActivityGrowth)*(1-residualIntensityImprovement))^t; only non-land, non-power native CO2 lacking an explicit sector pathway; activity also feeds passenger-EV electricity unless an explicit transport activity path replaces it
formulas.sectorActivityIntensity: ((1+sectorGrowth)*(1-sectorIntensityImprovement))^min(t,trendEndYear-2024), all gases in that exact classified sector; transport activity, but not residual intensity, also feeds EV electricity
formulas.overlap: For the same native baseline stock use maximum delivered reduction, never additive or multiplicative stacking; an explicit scoped measure replaces a weaker generic/technical reduction. Power always follows the electricity balance, not generic/scoped reduction.
formulas.signedLand: Persistence or explicit multiplicative native land pathway preserves sign. A fractional emissions-abatement measure on a negative land sink refuses; no zero clamp and no invented removal efficacy.
